title: Closing the Loop on Contrail Avoidance with Satellite Verification
title_zh: 通过卫星验证实现航迹云规避的闭环

paragraphs.en: Contrails are the thin ice clouds that aircraft leave behind. They cause a large share of aviation’s warming, and rerouting the few flights that produce them could avoid much of it. However, an avoided contrail only counts if a satellite can confirm that it never formed, and this check is hard: contrails are one to two pixels wide, cover only 0.18 % 0.18\% of pixels, and look very similar to natural cirrus. We build a small diffusion model (8.4M parameters, trained on one GPU) that detects them, and we run a controlled study to find out which components matter. The model reaches 0.476 0.476 PR-AUC, compared with 0.414 0.414 for a DeepLabV3+ baseline and 0.119 0.119 for an adapted MedSegDiff. Doubling the input resolution of the CNN brings it to parity ( 0.499 0.499 , p = 0.07 p{=}0.07 ). Three lessons apply beyond contrails. First, check the input resolution before designing a new architecture. Second, simple flips and rotations more than double accuracy and matter more than any architectural choice we measured. Third, pretraining the model on contrail shapes is harmful: the model learns that thin strokes appear everywhere and paints them onto empty scenes. Precision collapses to 1 % 1\% while recall-based metrics still rate the degraded model as excellent, and no threshold or guidance heuristic repairs this failure.
paragraphs.zh: 凝结尾是飞机飞行时留下的薄冰云。 它们导致了航空业大量温室效应，而改变产生这些凝结尾的少数航班航线，或许可以避免其中大部分影响。 然而，只有当卫星能够确认某条凝结尾从未形成时，它才算被成功避免；而这种验证十分困难：凝结尾的宽度仅为一到两个像素，仅覆盖 0.18% 的像素，且外观与自然卷云极为相似。 我们构建了一个小型扩散模型（840 万个参数，使用单 GPU 训练）来检测凝结尾，并开展了一项受控研究，以明确哪些组件具有重要影响。 该模型达到了 0.476 的 PR-AUC，而 DeepLabV3+ 基线模型为 0.414，经过调整的 MedSegDiff 模型则为 0.119。 将 CNN 的输入分辨率翻倍后，其性能达到与基准相当的水平（0.499，p = 0.07）。 这三点经验不仅适用于凝结尾问题。 首先，在设计新架构之前，应先检查输入分辨率。 其次，简单的翻转和旋转操作可将准确率提升一倍以上，其影响比我们测试过的任何架构选择都更为关键。 第三，在凝结尾形状上进行预训练会对模型造成负面影响：模型会误以为薄线条无处不在，并因此在空白场景中绘制出这些线条。 此时精确率骤降至 1%，而基于召回率的指标仍将退化后的模型评为“优秀”；任何阈值设置或引导启发式方法都无法修复这一缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Aviation warms the climate in two ways: by emitting CO 2 and by producing condensation trails. Contrails that persist spread into cirrus-like sheets that trap outgoing heat, and contrail cirrus is assessed as the largest single component of aviation’s effective radiative forcing, although the uncertainty is wide [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . About 2 % 2\% of flights cause 80 % 80\% of annual contrail energy forcing [ 3 ] , and small changes in route or altitude let an aircraft avoid the ice-supersaturated layers in which contrails form [ 4 ] . Unlike CO 2 warming, this warming can therefore be reduced quickly and at low cost.
paragraphs.zh: 航空业通过两种方式加剧气候变暖：排放二氧化碳和产生凝结尾迹。 持续存在的凝结尾迹会扩散成类似卷云的云层，从而困住向外散发的热量；据评估，凝结尾迹卷云是航空业有效辐射强迫中最大的单一组成部分，尽管其不确定性很大 [1, 2, 3]。 大约 2% 的航班造成了年度凝结尾迹能量强迫的 80% [3]，而航线或海拔高度的微小调整就能让飞机避开形成凝结尾迹的冰超饱和层 [4]。 因此，与二氧化碳引起的变暖不同，这种变暖效应可以快速且低成本地减少。

paragraphs.en: In August 2026 the UK government, NATS, the Met Office, Google and academic partners launched Operation Blue Skies, a £5M programme that applies AI-recommended altitude changes in Shanwick oceanic airspace, which accounts for about 5 % 5\% of global contrail warming, over the winters of 2026–27 and 2027–28 [ 5 , 6 ] . A programme of this scale is only as credible as the measurement that follows it, and that measurement comes from satellite imagery: to claim that a contrail was avoided, someone must check whether it formed [ 7 ] . This measurement step, rather than forecasting or routing, is the focus of this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年8月，英国政府、NATS、英国气象局、谷歌及学术合作伙伴共同启动了“蓝天行动”（Operation Blue Skies），这是一项耗资500万英镑的计划，旨在2026–27和2027–28年冬季期间，在占全球凝结尾变暖效应约5%的5\% 的尚威克海洋空域中应用人工智能推荐的航高调整方案 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 如此规模的计划其可信度完全取决于后续的实际测量结果，而这一测量结果来自卫星图像：要声称某条凝结尾被成功避免，就必须有人核实它是否确实没有形成 [ 7 ] 。 本文的重点正是这一测量环节，而非预测或航线规划。

paragraphs.en: OpenContrails [ 8 ] turned this task into a public benchmark with about 22,000 human-labeled scenes from GOES-16 imagery [ 9 ] . Three properties make the task difficult. The targets are thin : one or two pixels wide, so a small positional error destroys the overlap with the label. They are sparse : 0.18 % 0.18\% of test pixels are positive and 70 % 70\% of images are empty. And they are nearly indistinguishable from the hardest negatives, because thin cirrus shares their shape, brightness and texture ( fig. 1 ). We therefore try a generative approach. A diffusion network [ 10 ] builds its answer by repeated refinement rather than by a single forward pass, so it can return to a faint line instead of averaging it away. Running it several times also produces several masks, and their disagreement is a usable confidence signal. Diffusion has been applied to segmentation [ 11 ] and to thin tubular medical targets [ 12 ] , but whether its advantages survive a task this imbalanced had not been tested.
paragraphs.zh: OpenContrails [ 8 ] 将这项任务转化为一个公开基准，其中包含了约 22,000 个来自 GOES-16 图像 [ 9 ] 的人类标注场景。 三个特性使这项任务变得困难。 目标非常细：仅宽一两个像素，因此微小的定位误差就会破坏其与标签的重叠。 它们分布稀疏：测试像素中仅有 0.18% 是阳性样本，70% 的图像为空。 而且它们几乎与最难区分的阴性样本无法分辨，因为细卷云具有相同的形状、亮度和纹理（图 1）。 因此，我们尝试采用一种生成式方法。 扩散网络 [ 10 ] 通过反复优化而非单次前向传播来构建结果，因此它能够重新关注到微弱的线条，而不是将其平均掉。 多次运行该网络也会生成多个掩膜，而它们之间的差异可以作为一种可用的置信度信号。 扩散方法已被应用于分割任务 [ 11 ] 以及细管状医学目标 [ 12 ]，但它在如此不平衡的任务中是否仍能保持优势，此前尚未得到验证。

paragraphs.en: We answer this question in two parts. The first is a conditional diffusion network built for thin, linear structures. The second is a controlled study in which one protocol is frozen and every variant is retrained under it, including controls that give a conventional CNN the same test-time compute. Both parts are deliberately small (8.4M parameters against 26.7M for the baseline; 90 epochs on one GPU). This constraint is intentional: a verification pipeline that a weather service or a university group has to run cannot assume a large training budget. Two unexpected results are the part that transfers to other problems. Flip and rotation augmentation was the single most important ingredient, outweighing every architectural component we measured. Unconditional mask pretraining was actively harmful in a way that recall metrics do not reveal, and no threshold, calibration or classifier-free guidance [ 13 ] repairs it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个方面来回答这个问题。 第一方面是一个为薄而线性的结构构建的条件扩散网络。 第二方面是一项受控研究：其中一种协议被固定不变，所有变体都在该协议下重新训练，包括那些使传统 CNN 在测试时获得相同计算能力的对照实验。 这两个部分都刻意设计得规模较小（参数为 8.4M，而基线模型为 26.7M；在一块 GPU 上训练 90 个周期）。 这种限制是有意为之：气象服务或大学团队必须运行的验证流程，无法假设拥有庞大的训练预算。 两个出人意料的成果，正是能够迁移到其他问题的部分。 翻转和旋转增强是最关键的因素，其重要性超过了我们所测量的所有架构组件。 无条件掩码预训练实际上造成了负面影响，而这种影响是召回率指标无法揭示的，并且任何阈值设置、校准或无分类器引导 [13] 都无法修复这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Automatic contrail detection from satellite imagery has a long history. The classical approach is the linear-contrail detection algorithm of Mannstein et al. [14] , which applies oriented line filters to AVHRR brightness-temperature differences; it was later extended to geostationary imagers to follow contrails through their life cycle [ 15 ] . These hand-crafted detectors work well on bright, young contrails but miss faint or aged ones. Deep learning entered the field with Kulik [16] and Meijer et al. [17] , who trained CNN segmenters on GOES-16 data and used them to estimate contrail coverage over the United States. Ng et al. [8] released OpenContrails, the first large human-labeled dataset, together with a ResNet-based segmentation model trained under a large compute budget, and Geraedts et al. [7] built on it to attribute detected contrails to individual flights. A public Kaggle competition on the same data [ 18 ] showed that U-Net-style models with upsampled inputs and heavy test-time ensembling score well, and Chevallier et al. [19] combined detection, tracking and flight matching on Meteosat imagery. All of these detectors are single-pass discriminative models that report one score per pixel. Our work differs in three ways. We use an iterative generative model, which gives a per-pixel uncertainty map from the disagreement between samples. We train under a small, fixed budget, so that every baseline can be retrained under identical conditions and compared fairly. And we report which training choices matter, including one that silently fails, rather than only a headline score.
paragraphs.zh: 从卫星图像中自动探测航迹云已有悠久的历史。 经典方法是 Mannstein 等人提出的线性航迹云探测算法。 [14]，该算法将定向线滤波器应用于 AVHRR 亮度温度差异；后来该方法被扩展至静止轨道成像仪，以便追踪航迹云在整个生命周期中的变化 [15]。 这些人工设计的探测器对明亮的新生航迹云效果良好，但会漏掉较暗或已老化的航迹云。 Kulik [16] 和 Meijer 等人引入了深度学习技术到该领域。 [17]，他们在 GOES-16 数据上训练了 CNN 分割模型，并利用这些模型估算美国境内的航迹云覆盖范围。Ng 等人 [8] 发布了 OpenContrails——首个大规模人工标注数据集，并附上了在大量计算资源下训练的基于 ResNet 的分割模型；Geraedts 等人 [7] 在此基础上进一步开发，将探测到的航迹云归因到具体航班。 在同一数据上举办的 Kaggle 公开竞赛 [18] 表明，采用上采样输入并在测试阶段进行大量模型融合的 U-Net 风格模型表现优异；Chevallier 等人 [19] 则将探测、追踪和航班匹配结合应用于 Meteosat 图像。 所有这些探测器都是单通道的判别式模型，每个像素仅输出一个分数。 我们的工作在三个方面有所不同。 我们使用了一种迭代生成模型，通过样本之间的差异生成每个像素的不确定性地图。 我们在有限且固定的计算资源下训练模型，这样所有基线模型都可以在相同条件下重新训练并进行公平比较。 此外，我们还报告了哪些训练选择具有重要影响（包括一个会静默失败的选项），而不仅仅是给出一个总体的分数。

sents.en: Automatic contrail detection from satellite imagery has a long history.
sents.zh: 从卫星图像中自动探测航迹云已有悠久的历史。

sents.en: The classical approach is the linear-contrail detection algorithm of Mannstein et al.
sents.zh: 经典方法是 Mannstein 等人提出的线性航迹云探测算法。

sents.en: [14] , which applies oriented line filters to AVHRR brightness-temperature differences; it was later extended to geostationary imagers to follow contrails through their life cycle [ 15 ] .
sents.zh: [14]，该算法将定向线滤波器应用于 AVHRR 亮度温度差异；后来该方法被扩展至静止轨道成像仪，以便追踪航迹云在整个生命周期中的变化 [15]。

sents.en: These hand-crafted detectors work well on bright, young contrails but miss faint or aged ones.
sents.zh: 这些人工设计的探测器对明亮的新生航迹云效果良好，但会漏掉较暗或已老化的航迹云。

sents.en: Deep learning entered the field with Kulik [16] and Meijer et al.
sents.zh: Kulik [16] 和 Meijer 等人引入了深度学习技术到该领域。

sents.en: [17] , who trained CNN segmenters on GOES-16 data and used them to estimate contrail coverage over the United States. Ng et al.
sents.zh: [17]，他们在 GOES-16 数据上训练了 CNN 分割模型，并利用这些模型估算美国境内的航迹云覆盖范围。Ng 等人

sents.en: [8] released OpenContrails, the first large human-labeled dataset, together with a ResNet-based segmentation model trained under a large compute budget, and Geraedts et al.
sents.zh: [8] 发布了 OpenContrails——首个大规模人工标注数据集，并附上了在大量计算资源下训练的基于 ResNet 的分割模型；Geraedts 等人

sents.en: [7] built on it to attribute detected contrails to individual flights.
sents.zh: [7] 在此基础上进一步开发，将探测到的航迹云归因到具体航班。

sents.en: A public Kaggle competition on the same data [ 18 ] showed that U-Net-style models with upsampled inputs and heavy test-time ensembling score well, and Chevallier et al.
sents.zh: 在同一数据上举办的 Kaggle 公开竞赛 [18] 表明，采用上采样输入并在测试阶段进行大量模型融合的 U-Net 风格模型表现优异；Chevallier 等人

sents.zh: [19] 则将探测、追踪和航班匹配结合应用于 Meteosat 图像。

sents.en: All of these detectors are single-pass discriminative models that report one score per pixel.
sents.zh: 所有这些探测器都是单通道的判别式模型，每个像素仅输出一个分数。

sents.en: Our work differs in three ways.
sents.zh: 我们的工作在三个方面有所不同。

sents.en: We use an iterative generative model, which gives a per-pixel uncertainty map from the disagreement between samples.
sents.zh: 我们使用了一种迭代生成模型，通过样本之间的差异生成每个像素的不确定性地图。

sents.en: We train under a small, fixed budget, so that every baseline can be retrained under identical conditions and compared fairly.
sents.zh: 我们在有限且固定的计算资源下训练模型，这样所有基线模型都可以在相同条件下重新训练并进行公平比较。

sents.en: And we report which training choices matter, including one that silently fails, rather than only a headline score.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还报告了哪些训练选择具有重要影响（包括一个会静默失败的选项），而不仅仅是给出一个总体的分数。

paragraphs.en: Contrails share their geometry with retinal vessels, roads, cracks and power lines: they are thin, long, connected, and a tiny fraction of the image. Work on these targets shows that per-pixel losses are the wrong objective, because a one-pixel shift destroys the overlap while leaving the shape intact. Topology-aware losses address this directly. Mosinska et al. [20] penalize differences between deep features of the prediction and the label, Hu et al. [21] match persistent-homology features, and clDice [ 22 ] compares the skeletons of prediction and label so that connectivity, rather than area, is rewarded. We adopt clDice because it is cheap to compute and it targets the failure we see most often, broken lines. Focal loss [ 23 ] is the standard answer to extreme class imbalance. The straightness of contrails links them to line detection: deep Hough-transform priors [ 24 , 25 ] accumulate evidence along candidate lines and improve the detection of faint straight structures. Our soft-Hough encoder is a fixed, lightweight version of this idea. Finally, diffusion models have been used for general segmentation [ 11 ] and for medical targets such as vessels and tumours [ 12 ] , and Wolleb et al. [26] showed that repeated sampling yields an implicit ensemble whose variance is a useful uncertainty estimate. We adapt MedSegDiff’s frequency-domain conditioning to be direction-aware and use the same sampling ensemble for uncertainty, but to our knowledge none of these methods had been tested on a target this sparse.
paragraphs.zh: 凝结尾迹的几何形态与视网膜血管、道路、裂缝和电线相似：它们纤细、修长、相互连接，且仅占图像的一小部分。 针对这些目标的研究表明，逐像素损失并非合适的优化目标，因为仅一个像素的偏移就会破坏重叠区域，而形状本身却保持不变。 拓扑感知损失直接解决了这一问题。Mosinska 等人 [20] 对预测结果与标签之间的深层特征差异进行惩罚，Hu 等人 [21] 匹配持久同调特征，而 clDice [22] 则通过比较预测结果与标签的骨架结构，使连通性而非面积成为优化目标。 我们采用 clDice，因为它计算成本低，且能针对我们最常遇到的失败情况——断裂的线条——进行优化。 焦点损失 [23] 是应对极端类别不平衡问题的标准解决方案。 凝结尾迹的直线特性使其与线条检测相关联：深度霍夫变换先验 [24, 25] 会沿着候选线条积累证据，从而提升对微弱直线结构的检测能力。 我们的软霍夫编码器是这一思路的一个固定且轻量化的版本。 最后，扩散模型已被用于通用分割 [11] 以及血管和肿瘤等医学目标 [12]，Wolleb 等人 [26] 指出，重复采样可以生成一个隐式集成模型，其方差可作为有效的不确定性估计。 我们将 MedSegDiff 的频率域条件化方法调整为方向感知模式，并使用相同的采样集成来评估不确定性；但据我们所知，这些方法中尚无一例在如此稀疏的目标上得到过测试。

paragraphs.en: The design follows three properties of the target. Contrails are thin , so a network that downsamples the image aggressively loses them; we therefore keep a decoder branch that never downsamples. Contrails are straight , because aircraft fly close to great-circle paths; fixed directional line-averaging filters (a “soft Hough” encoder) supply this prior, although our ablation cannot separate its effect from noise ( + 0.005 +0.005 , p = 0.35 p{=}0.35 ). Contrails also move and grow between frames while cirrus mostly does not, so frame differences provide a motion cue.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计遵循目标对象的三个特性。 凝结尾很细，因此对图像进行激进下采样的网络会丢失它们；为此，我们保留了一个从不进行下采样的解码器分支。 凝结尾是直的，因为飞机飞行路径接近大圆航线；固定方向的线平均滤波器（一种“软霍夫”编码器）提供了这一先验信息，尽管我们的消融研究无法将其效应与噪声区分开来（+0.005 +0.005，p=0.35）。 凝结尾在帧与帧之间也会移动和增长，而卷云通常不会，因此帧差异可以提供运动线索。

paragraphs.en: We follow the standard diffusion recipe [ 10 ] . The mask is corrupted with Gaussian noise at a random level, and a network learns to predict the noise that was added, conditioned on four infrared frames. Conditioning features enter at every scale and are modulated by the noise level [ 27 ] . They come from the two encoders above, from an image encoder borrowed from super-resolution [ 28 ] , and from a direction-aware version of MedSegDiff’s frequency filter [ 12 ] . Three auxiliary losses act on the reconstructed mask: focal loss [ 23 ] for the extreme imbalance; soft clDice [ 22 ] , which rewards thin predictions that stay connected and punishes broken ones; and a distance term that penalizes predicted mass far from any label. Flips and rotations up to ± 30 ∘ \pm 30^{\circ} are applied jointly to the image sequence and the mask. At test time we generate N N masks [ 29 ] and keep the pixels on which at least 60 % 60\% of them agree, discarding connected components smaller than 50 pixels. The mean of the masks is a dense confidence map, and their disagreement is a per-pixel uncertainty map.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循标准的扩散流程 [ 10 ] 。 掩膜以随机强度被高斯噪声污染，一个网络在四个红外帧的条件下学习预测所添加的噪声。 条件特征在每个尺度层输入，并由噪声水平进行调制 [ 27 ] 。 这些特征来自上述两个编码器：一个从超分辨率技术中借用而来的图像编码器 [ 28 ] ，以及 MedSegDiff 频率滤波器的方向感知版本 [ 12 ] 。 三种辅助损失作用于重建的掩膜：用于应对极端不平衡问题的焦点损失 [ 23 ]；软 clDice 损失 [ 22 ]，它奖励保持连接的薄预测结果，并惩罚断裂的预测；以及一个对远离任何标签的预测区域施加惩罚的距离项。 对图像序列和掩膜同时应用最大 ± 30 ∘ \pm 30^{\circ} 的翻转和旋转操作。 在测试阶段，我们生成 N 个掩膜 [ 29 ]，保留至少 60 % 的掩膜在像素上达成一致的区域，并丢弃小于 50 像素的连接组件。 掩膜的均值构成一个密集的信心度图，而它们之间的差异则构成一个逐像素的不确定性图。

paragraphs.en: We use the full OpenContrails release [ 8 ] : 20,529 training scenes and 1,856 validation scenes. Each scene is a 256 × 256 256\times 256 crop with four infrared frames and one human-labeled mask. Because the official test set is not public, we split the validation scenes once, with a fixed seed, into a val-tune half and a test half (928 scenes each) and froze both halves before any experiment. paragraphs.en: We report three metrics. PR-AUC is computed over all test pixels. Skeleton recall is the fraction of the label’s centerline that the prediction covers; it answers “did we find it?”. HD 95 is a worst-case geometric error that is driven by distant false-positive blobs. DeepLabV3+ [ 30 ] with an ImageNet-initialized ResNet-50 encoder [ 31 , 32 ] and MedSegDiff [ 12 ] are both trained by us under identical data, splits, budget, post-processing and metric code. The published OpenContrails model is an external reference that was trained under a much larger budget; the gap to it is not a labeling or prevalence artifact ( appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Table 1 gives the main finding: our model gains + 0.062 +0.062 PR-AUC over DeepLabV3+ at a matched 256 2 256^{2} input ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.038 , 0.088 ] [0.038,0.088] ) and reaches four times the score of the adapted MedSegDiff. Our number comes from a 20-sample ensemble while the CNN’s comes from a single pass, so we also give the CNN the same test-time budget. Eight-fold test-time augmentation and a five-seed deep ensemble [ 33 ] ( 0.438 0.438 ) each close less than half of the gap. A discriminative twin , which uses the same encoders and losses but is trained as a one-shot segmenter with the mask branch zeroed, falls below the plain CNN. paragraphs.en: Contrail avoidance is a rare case of a large, fast and cheap climate lever whose bottleneck is measurement rather than engineering. An operational programme forecasts the ice-supersaturated regions, reroutes the few flights that would cross them, and verifies from satellite imagery whether the contrail failed to appear. Only the verification step closes the loop. Without trustworthy detection, a programme cannot tell a successful diversion from a wrong forecast, and it cannot support the accounting that a mandate would require. The users are concrete: evaluators of trials such as Blue Skies, per-flight attribution pipelines [ 7 ] , and eventually a regulator asked to certify avoided warming.
paragraphs.zh: 避免凝结尾迹是一个罕见的大规模、快速且低成本的气候干预案例，其瓶颈在于测量而非工程实现。 一项运行计划会预测冰超饱和区域，为少数可能穿越这些区域的航班调整航线，并通过卫星图像验证凝结尾迹是否未能形成。 只有验证步骤才能完成整个闭环。 如果没有可靠的探测手段，该计划就无法区分成功的航线调整与错误的预测，也无法支持法规所要求的问责机制。 其使用者是具体的：例如“蓝天计划”等试验的评估者、每次航班的归因流程 [7]，以及最终需要认证所避免的变暖程度的监管机构。

paragraphs.en: A verifier that over-reports avoided contrails turns an avoidance programme into a greenwashing instrument, and one that mis-attributes assigns the cost to the wrong operator. The failure mode we document therefore matters more than the headline number. Attribution filters false positives against flight tracks, but hallucinated contrail- shaped strokes are more likely than blobs to land near a real track. This is why we foreground the pretraining collapse over its flattering 0.96 0.96 skeleton recall. The structured vote variance ( fig. 2(b) ) can route doubtful detections to review, which turns our 42 % 42\% false-positive rate on empty scenes into a review burden rather than a silent error.
paragraphs.zh: 过度报告被规避航迹云的验证器会将规避计划变成一种“洗绿”工具，而错误归因的验证器则会将成本转嫁给错误的运营商。 因此，我们所记录的系统失效模式比表面数据更为重要。 归因机制能过滤掉与飞行轨迹相关的误报，但幻象出的航迹云形状笔触比模糊斑块更可能落在真实轨迹附近。 正因如此，我们才强调预训练阶段的崩溃问题，而非其看似不错的 0.96 骨架召回率。 结构化投票方差（图 2(b)）可将可疑检测结果引导至复核流程，从而将空场景中 42% 的误报率转化为复核负担，而非悄无声息的错误。

paragraphs.en: MedSegDiff is the official implementation adapted to this dataset (MedSegDiff-B recipe). Of its two output heads, the calibration head was selected on val-tune and only that head was scored on test. It keeps its own single-frame conditioning and loss stack, which is its published design. paragraphs.zh: MedSegDiff 是为此数据集（MedSegDiff-B 配方）调整的官方实现。 在其两个输出头中，校准头在验证集调优阶段被选中，且仅该头在测试集上进行评分。 它保留了自己的单帧条件输入和损失堆栈，这正是其已发布的设计。 在同一配方和预算下，基于全部四帧进行控制的重新运行得分更低（测试集 PR-AUC 为 0.033 0.033，对比 0.119 0.119），因此表格中报告的是性能更强的变体。

paragraphs.en: The external reference row ( 0.651 0.651 ) is not a within-protocol comparison: the model was trained under a much larger budget and evaluated on the full 1,856-scene pool. The gap is not a labeling artifact, because per-scene positive-pixel counts for all 1,856 raw validation masks match our preprocessed masks exactly. It is also not a prevalence artifact: measured prevalence is 0.181 % 0.181\% over the pool and 0.184 % 0.184\% over our test half, so the often-quoted 1.2 % 1.2\% figure describes their contrail-enriched training set, not the evaluation pool.
paragraphs.zh: 外部参考行（0.651 0.651）并非协议内比较：该模型是在大得多的预算下训练的，并在全部 1,856 个场景的池子上进行了评估。 这种差异并非标注造成的伪影，因为所有 1,856 个原始验证掩码中每个场景的正向像素计数与我们的预处理掩码完全一致。 这也不是流行度造成的伪影：在整个场景池中测得的流行度为 0.181% 0.181\%，在我们测试的半数场景中则为 0.184% 0.184\%，因此经常被引用的 1.2% 1.2\% 这一数据描述的是他们富含尾迹的训练集，而非评估池。
